acceptance_criteria: consensus-fix supports --require-rails (exiting 1 via opError when --rails is omitted) and documents in the exit-code table that exit 0 without --rails does not mean the regression gate ran (#603).
consensus-fix README.md and --help document that --prompt-only uses a placeholder for test output so source excerpts may differ from a live run (#606).
gate-fuzzing writeReproArtifact sets defeat.scaffoldPath (written path or null) and gate-fuzzing --json includes scaffoldPath on each defeat when --record is used (#650).
description: Resolves #603, #606, and #650. Add --require-rails to consensus-fix and document in its exit-code table that exit 0 without --rails does not imply the regression gate ran (#603); document in consensus-fix README and --help that --prompt-only substitutes a placeholder for test output so source excerpts may differ from a live run (#606); and record scaffoldPath on the defeat and in gate-fuzzing --json output when --record writes packages/<target>/test/bypass-<id>.test.mjs (#650).
title: consensus-fix,gate-fuzzing: add --require-rails, document --prompt-only placeholder, and surface scaffoldPath (#603, #606, #650)
